channel.title: W3Footprint Blog
channel.description: Practical articles on app publishing, Android and data engineering.

item.title: Google Play closed testing: how to get a new developer account to production
item.description: New personal Google Play accounts must run a closed test before they can publish. Here is how it works, how to find testers, and the mistakes that restart the clock.

item.title: Why Google Play rejects apps: 7 common reasons and how to fix them
item.description: Most Google Play rejections come from the same handful of issues. Here are the seven we see most often, and what to change before you resubmit.

item.title: Android app release checklist: 15 things to check before you upload
item.description: A practical pre-release checklist for Android apps: signing, versioning, target API, permissions, testing and store listing, in the order you should do them.

item.title: How to clean messy business data in 5 steps
item.description: Spreadsheets, exports and scattered files do not need a big platform to fix. This five-step process turns messy data into numbers a team can trust.

item.title: Building FriLuft: lessons from a Swedish outdoor weather app
item.description: What we learned building FriLuft, an Android weather app that uses open Swedish data, offline caching and an outdoor score, from design to Google Play review.
